text:
sophie: nightly-eval alert: huge drop on `summarize_descriptions` prompt set for grove-7b-quant after yesterday's runtime swap. samples have repetitive clauses and invented dates. linking eval ID 0x9f3a
nightly-bot: eval 0x9f3a: perf delta -18% on ROUGE-L, failure rate 32% -> alert created: https://ci.internal/evals/0x9f3a :rotating_light:
mike_r: can someone paste a couple of failing generations? quick look pls
laura: grabbed two examples from the run:
```
Input: "Describe the founding of AcmeCorp in two sentences."
Output: "AcmeCorp was founded in 1998 by John Doe. In 1999 John Doe founded AcmeCorp again, and in 1998 they incorporated in 1999."  <-- looped dates
```
```
Input: "Summarize this product description"
Output: "This product helps you manage tasks. This product helps you manage tasks. This product helps you manage tasks. For details see 2022 release notes."  <-- repetition
```
laura: both are from greedy/beam and top-p sampling configs in nightly harness (sampling seed randomized)
oliver: fwiw the runtime swap yesterday touched the attention memory layout + KV prefetch order. PR 0a1b2c made block layout change to improve throughput. that could change token ordering interactions with sampling state @eng-runtime
infra-bot: deploy: runtime/commit/0a1b2c -> prod-edge1 at 2026-03-30T22:12:11Z
mike_r: hmm. do we see same fail on cpu reference path or on old runtime? can we rerun eval against previous runtime binary?
laura: queued re-run against runtime/commit/zz9x8 (previous) with same eval harness, keep seeds: true. job 0x9f3a-rerun-old started
ashley: odd regression surfaced in customer demo yesterday too, cc: product
laura: rerun finished: old runtime pass rate 95%, new runtime pass rate 68% (same model artifact, same quant config)
mike_r: that strongly points at serving runtime change, not quantization or model
oliver: possible culprits: KV ordering + cache invalidation timing + RNG consumption shift. small changes in token emission can cascade with sampling to produce repeats.
laura: i attached low-level logits trace (truncated) from failing sample:
```
Step 12 logits top-5: [3.2, 3.1, 3.05, 3.04, 0.1]
Step 13 logits top-5: [3.2, 3.19, 3.05, 3.04, 0.09]
Note: tiny deltas where tie-breaking used to be stable now flips repeatedly -> causes tie loops in top-p sampling impl.
```
mike_r: do we have a reproducible minimal repro invoking runtime locally? can try bisecting the commit between zz9x8 and 0a1b2c
oliver: yes, i can run a micro-repro with same model and prompt quickly. will instrument RNG draw counts and KV store timestamps.
sophie: action items: 1) oliver run micro-repro + attach logs (due today), 2) eng-runtime to bisect commit if repro confirmed (mike_r), 3) add regression test to nightly harness covering summarize_descriptions prompt set and seed-controlled sampling (laura)
mike_r: also add a deterministic-seed mode in the harness so we can replay exact RNG sequence across runtimes
laura: added ticket INF-8472 for deterministic replay harness
oliver: quick note: initial micro-repro shows same repeat when running runtime with new layout + same seed. when I force `force_stable_softmax=true` the repetition disappears. suspect softmax normalization path changed numeric order of operations.
laura: can you dump kv keys/timestamps around the loop? that would help decide if ordering or numeric noise
oliver: attaching snippet:
```
KV at step 11: [kA@1001, kB@1002, kC@1003]
KV at step 12: [kB@1002, kA@1001, kC@1003]  # ordering swap
```
oliver: ordering swap coincides with tiny logits flip, which flips argmax and then sampling draws the same token repeatedly -> repetition avalanche
mike_r: ok that's actionable. plan: revert layout change in canary, run full nightly eval. if regression disappears we pin a fix or adjust softmax stability and add test.
ashley: please keep me posted; we had customer impact. thx :pray:
sophie: thanks everyone. if no objections i'll open a rollback PR and coordinate canary tomorrow morning. tagging @eng-runtime for on-call follow-up. :white_check_mark:
